name: @office/domain-organization
description: Office organization domain module (OFF-007): the canonical tenant-scoped Organization aggregate with create/update/archive lifecycle commands, deny-by-default authorization through @office/authz, audit events through a minimal typed EventSink port (transactional with the repository write), and deterministic Office-issued canonical ids. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/persistence.
